speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an 8-month-old boy experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me if you have been vomiting, and if so, is the vomit green or forceful?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception.

The worsening pain on palpation, feeding difficulties, and abdominal distension are classic signs; I suspect a telescoping of the bowel. Do you notice any "red currant jelly" stools or have you seen blood in the diaper recently?
